title: Sunny, pouring, sunny again
old_caption: Sunny, pouring, sunny again, and the weather star spun until it got dizzy. Today's forecast: yes. That's not weather, that's a situationship. Which sign sends the most mixed signals?

title: Chakra
old_caption: Seven chakra stars, one line. Root is squashed, crown is asleep, and heart is swiping. In yoga. Which of your chakras needs a talking-to today?

title: Moon
old_caption: Cancer waited on read for one entire moon cycle: hopeful on day 1, a cobweb by day 29. Then the phone buzzed. It was a moon notification. Longest you've ever waited on a reply?

title: Aura
old_caption: Bio: chill. Aura: chaos, chatty, nosy, deep, broody, dreamy, dramatic. Gemini says it's a phase. Which color is your bio hiding?

title: Deck
old_caption: Aries rode the card carousel like a fairground horse yelling NEXT until the stars slammed the brakes and launched it off. Then it actually read one. Who's always saying next?

title: Zodiac
old_caption: DJ Stars spins the zodiac: Aries dances on top, Cancer cries on top, Libra can't pick a direction, and Capricorn grips the top seat because it was earned. Babe, it's a wheel.

title: Constellation
old_caption: Sag knows everyone. Him, her, and HIM. Pretty soon the whole sky is one big tangled knot. Then the stars snip every line but one. Who's the Sag connecting your whole circle?

title: Orbit
old_caption: Taurus and Libra have been orbiting each other for weeks: peek, get caught, look away, repeat. Pisces is in the corner holding a SAY HI sign and sobbing. Who are you orbiting?

title: Hyperspace
old_caption: Sag hit light speed, yelled WOO, and flew straight past six people before the stars slammed the brakes. Pisces just wanted to know if we're there yet. Who's your fastest-moving friend?

title: Talk
old_caption: Virgo: 'so, nice weather?' Aquarius: 'it's very weathery.' Synchronized sip. Then Gemini swooped in with a talk card and they both flipped the same answer. What's your hill to die on?
